title: Row-Bot company policy
description:
The company's policy for every connected Row-Bot. A setting it leaves out takes its default. Unknown keys are refused.

| Setting | Default | In a group override | Lockdown |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `models.allowed` | * | every entry the company or any of the person's groups allows | [] |
| `models.personal_api_keys` | false | on if the company or any of the person's groups turns it on | false |
| `models.consumer_sign_ins` | false | on if the company or any of the person's groups turns it on | false |
| `models.local_models` | true | on if the company or any of the person's groups turns it on | true |
| `tools.disabled_groups` | [] | `tools.enabled_groups`: the company's list, less every entry any of the person's groups gives back | agents, arxiv, browser, calendar, computer_use, conversation_setup, custom_tool_builder, designer, developer, duckduckgo, file_delivery, gmail, image_gen, linked_conversations, mcp, outlook_calendar, outlook_mail, shell, sound, system_info, task, url_reader, video_editing, video_gen, vision, waits, weather, web_search, wiki, wikipedia, wolfram_alpha, x, youtube |
| `tools.disabled_tools` | [] | `tools.enabled_tools`: the company's list, less every entry any of the person's groups gives back | [] |
| `approvals.max_level` | auto | the most permissive of the company's and the groups' values | block |
| `apps.plugins` | any | the most permissive of the company's and the groups' values | none |
| `apps.allowed_plugins` | [] | every entry the company or any of the person's groups allows | [] |
| `apps.mcp_servers` | any | the most permissive of the company's and the groups' values | none |
| `apps.allowed_mcp_servers` | [] | every entry the company or any of the person's groups allows | [] |
| `apps.skills_hub` | any | the most permissive of the company's and the groups' values | none |
| `apps.allowed_skills` | [] | every entry the company or any of the person's groups allows | [] |
| `apps.channels` | allow-list | the most permissive of the company's and the groups' values | none |
| `apps.allowed_channels` | discord, slack, sms, telegram | every entry the company or any of the person's groups allows | [] |
| `data.chat_export` | true | on if the company or any of the person's groups turns it on | false |
| `data.share_to_company` | true | on if the company or any of the person's groups turns it on | false |
| `offline.max_days` | 7 | the most permissive of the company's and the groups' values | 0 |

version.title: Version
version.description: The server's version of this document. On a write, the version it replaces (refused when that is no longer the newest).

models.title: Models
models.description: Which models people may use, and how they reach them.

allowed.title: Allowed catalog models
allowed.description: Company catalog model ids people may use; * is every model in the catalog. Default: *.

personal_api_keys.title: Allow personal API keys
personal_api_keys.description: Whether people may add their own API keys and custom endpoints. Default: false.

consumer_sign_ins.title: Allow consumer sign-ins
consumer_sign_ins.description: Whether people may sign in with a consumer subscription (Claude plan, ChatGPT/Codex, xAI Grok, OpenCode Go). Default: false.

local_models.title: Allow local models
local_models.description: Whether people may run models on their own computer (Ollama, llama.cpp). Default: true.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Which of Row-Bot's tools are switched off.

disabled_groups.title: Disabled tool groups
disabled_groups.description: Registry tools switched off, with every tool they offer (for example shell, browser, computer_use, developer). Default: [].

disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools
disabled_tools.description: Single model-facing tools switched off (for example run_command). Default: [].

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: How far people may let Row-Bot act without asking.

max_level.title: Highest approval level
max_level.description: The highest approval level anyone may choose: block, approve (Ask), auto or full (Hands-off). Default: auto.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Which plugins, MCP servers, Skills Hub skills and channels people may use.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: none, allow-list (only allowed_plugins) or any. Default: any.

allowed_plugins.title: Allowed plugins
allowed_plugins.description: Plugin ids, used when plugins is allow-list. Default: [].

mcp_servers.title: MCP servers
mcp_servers.description: none, allow-list (only allowed_mcp_servers) or any. Default: any.

allowed_mcp_servers.title: Allowed MCP servers
allowed_mcp_servers.description: MCP server names, used when mcp_servers is allow-list. Default: [].

skills_hub.title: Skills Hub
skills_hub.description: none, allow-list (only allowed_skills) or any. Default: any.

allowed_skills.title: Allowed skills
allowed_skills.description: Skills Hub skill ids, used when skills_hub is allow-list. Default: [].

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: none, allow-list (only allowed_channels) or any. Default: allow-list.

allowed_channels.title: Allowed channels
allowed_channels.description: Channel ids, used when channels is allow-list. The WhatsApp bridge (whatsapp) is unofficial, so it is allowed only when named. Default: discord, slack, sms, telegram.

data.title: Data
data.description: What people may take out of Row-Bot or offer to the company.

chat_export.title: Allow chat export
chat_export.description: Whether people may export their chats and data. Default: true.

share_to_company.title: Allow Share to company
share_to_company.description: Whether people may offer a document, fact or answer to the company (a space owner still approves it). Default: true.

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: How long a Row-Bot may keep working on its cached policy without reaching the server.

max_days.title: Offline days
max_days.description: Days a Row-Bot may run on its cached policy; after that it locks down to chat with local models only. 0 locks down as soon as the server can't be reached. Default: 7.
